author: single independent answering model; no agents or other recognition models
network_policy: All HTTP requests used HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY environment settings; edge-tts proxy was passed explicitly. No direct public connections. Python requests/curl did not fetch webpage-linked assets except the explicitly selected allowed species photos and sonograms. No blocklisted domain was requested. No input media or source audio was uploaded.
research_scope: Candidates were chosen from visible plumage, bill, posture, habitat and locally computed sonograms. Candidate audio references were used only to inspect general species note structure; no fingerprints, embeddings, cross-correlations, source searches, reverse image search, filenames or file metadata used for identification. Technical ffprobe metadata was used only for output format/timing validation.
limitations: No native audio listening tool. Audio observations are numerical/visual sonogram observations; subjective voice naturalness and sound timbre have not been directly auditioned. Search snippets were not treated as read source bodies. Some independent guide pages contain pre-existing translated text; no AI endpoint or identification feature on those sites was invoked.
